Author: Lalitha Kanneganti

 The Honourable Smt. Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 M.A.C.M.A.No.2272 of 2009
Judgment:

This appeal is filed by the Insurance Company aggrieved by the award dated 25.04.2008 in O.P.No.451 of 2005 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-cum-District Judge,
Mahabubnagar (for short 'the Tribunal').
2.

entities.text:
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-cum-District Judge,
Mahabubnagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Having heard Mr. Nasaraiah Golla, learned counsel for the Insurance Company, Mr. Mohammed Abdul Haleem, learned counsel for the respondents and perused the entire material available on record.
3. The claim petition was filed seeking compensation of Rs.2,50,000/- on account of death of the deceased in a motor accident, which took place on 31.03.2005.
The Tribunal has granted an amount of Rs.1,30,000/-.

4. The case of the claimants is that on 31.03.2005, the deceased boarded an auto from Mallepalli to Devarkonda and when the said auto reached the limits of Kolmunthalpahad Village, the auto met with an accident, as a result, the deceased received grievous injuries and died while undergoing treatment.
It is stated that at the time of accident, the deceased was hale and healthy and aged about 16 years and used to do coolie work and earn Rs.3,000/- per month.
Per contra, the Tribunal has taken the income as Rs.1,800/- per LK, J MACMA_2272_2009 month and deducted 1/3rd towards personal expenses and granted compensation of Rs.1,30,000/-.

5. Learned counsel appearing for the Insurance Company submitted that the deceased was aged about 16 years at the time of accident and without any basis, the Tribunal has taken the income at Rs.1,800/- per month and deducted only 1/3rd towards personal expenses but the Tribunal ought to have deducted 50% as he was a bachelor and the amount that was awarded by the Tribunal is excessive.
6. This is a case where the deceased was aged about 16 years and there is no evidence for income of the deceased.

The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Kurvan Ansari vs. Shyam Kishore Murmu1,
wherein the application is filed under Section 163-A of the Motor Vehicles Act, seeking compensation and has considered the notional income at Rs.25,000/- and by applying the multiplier of '15' has granted an amount of Rs.3,75,000/- for loss of dependency, Rs.80,000/- for The New India Assurance Co Limited vs Mohammed Abdul Rawoof And 3 Ors on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118885405/
1 loss of consortium and Rs.15,000/- for funeral expenses and altogether an amount of Rs.4,70,000/-
was granted.
7.

entities.text: Kurvan Ansari vs. Shyam Kishore Murmu1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: New India Assurance Co Limited vs Mohammed Abdul Rawoof And 3 Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the light of the law laid down in Kurvan Ansari's case (supra), the Tribunal ought to have granted an amount of Rs.4,70,000/-.
In this case, no appeal is filed by the claimants.
2021 SCC OnLine SC 1060 LK, J MACMA_2272_2009

However, the Act being a beneficial legislation, this Court having come to the conclusion that the compensation that was granted by the Tribunal was not just and reasonable that too in a case of death.

Without there being any appeal,
this Court can consider the case of the claimants for compensation.
8. Accordingly, the appeal of the Insurance Company is dismissed by enhancing the compensation awarded by the Tribunal from Rs.1,30,000/- to Rs.4,70,000/-.
(a) The enhanced amount shall carry interest at 7.5% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of realization.
(b) The claimants shall pay the court fee on the enhanced amount of compensation.
(c) The Insurance Company shall deposit the amount within a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
On such deposit, claimants are permitted to withdraw entire amount without furnishing any security.
No costs.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any

,
shall stand closed.

__ __ LALITHA KANNEGANTI, J Date: 16.06.2023 Pns LK, J MACMA_2272_2009 THE HONOURABLE SMT. JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI Dated 16.06.2023 PNS The New India Assurance Co Limited vs Mohammed Abdul Rawoof And 3 Ors on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118885405/
